name: Mesquite Crossing
summary: Mesquite Crossing is a community shopping center in Mesquite, Texas, offering diverse retail and dining options with competitive pricing. With a 4.3-star rating, customers appreciate its easy accessibility, variety of stores, and value-oriented shopping experience.
demographics: Mesquite Crossing serves a diverse, middle-income demographic in the eastern Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, attracting families and working professionals from Mesquite and surrounding communities. The trade area consists primarily of households with moderate to middle incomes, with a mix of young families, established homeowners, and value-conscious shoppers. Visitors typically seek convenient, everyday shopping options with competitive pricing, as evidenced by customer feedback highlighting "good deals and prices" and "fair price" offerings. The center draws from a broad suburban market that values accessibility and variety in their shopping experience.
description: Mesquite Crossing is a community shopping center located at 5690 North Town East Boulevard in Mesquite, Texas, serving the eastern Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area. This accessible retail destination offers visitors a diverse mix of shopping and dining options, with customers consistently praising its "plenty of variety in shopping" and convenient location. The center has earned a strong reputation among local shoppers, maintaining a 4.3-star rating from 438 reviews, with visitors particularly appreciating the competitive pricing and value offerings available throughout the property. Strategically positioned in Mesquite's retail corridor, the center provides easy access for residents and visitors alike, with ample parking and a straightforward layout that makes shopping efficient and enjoyable. Whether seeking everyday essentials, dining options, or specialty retail, Mesquite Crossing delivers a practical and welcoming shopping environment that has become a trusted destination for the local community.
